title: Reward Paid To The Shanghai City Government Police Bureau

page_data.en:
SECRET
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No............
Section 1, Special Br... Statistics,
REPORT
Date September 17, 1937.
Subject Reward paid to the Shanghai City Government Police Bureau.
Made by................and................Forwarded by D.I. Crawford

With reference to the remarks of the Acting Commissioner
of Police on the attached translation from the Chinese
newspaper "China Times," enquiries reveal that the money,
$10,000.00, was forwarded to the Commissioner of Shanghai
City Government Police Bureau by the Military Affairs
Commission of the Central Government. General Tai Lih,
who was responsible for General Tsai Chin Chun's appointment
as Commissioner and also the chiefs of Police Bureaux at
Hangchow, Quinsan and other towns in Chekiang and Kiangsu
provinces, is an influential member of the Military Affairs
Commission and therefore anything submitted by Mayor O. K.
Yui would have little affect.
General Tai Lih is leader of the Whampoa Students
Clique, better known by the name of the Blue Shirts, and
is a strong figure in the Central Tangpu.

Ag cd
C. Crawford
D. I.
（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER 17 SEP 1937 C. E. BRANCH）

机密
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号............
第一科，特别处... 统计，
报告
日期：1937年9月17日。
事由：向上海市政府警察局支付的奖金。
呈报人................及................转呈人：副督察长克劳福德（Crawford）

关于代理警务总监在附上的中文报纸《时事新报》译文旁的批注，经查询获悉，这笔款项计10,000.00元，是由中央政府军事委员会汇给上海市政府警察局局长的。戴笠将军负责任命蔡劲军为局长，以及浙江和江苏各省杭州、昆山等地警察局局长，他是军事委员会中有影响力的成员，因此俞鸿钧市长所提交的任何意见都不会产生太大影响。
戴笠将军是黄埔学生派系的领袖，该派系更为人熟知的名称是“蓝衣社”，他在中央党部中也是一位强势人物。

Ag cd
C. Crawford

September 13, 1937.    |    Afternoon Translation
                                  * SHANGHAI

China Times and other local newspapers :-

$10,000 REWARD FOR OFFICERS OF LOCAL POLICE BUREAU

    Since the outbreak of the local hostilities, all
officers of the Shanghai City Government Police Bureau, from
the Commissioner downwards, have been carrying out their
duties energetically, both participating in the fighting
at the front and maintaining order in the rear.    In view
of this, the National Government has ordered a reward of
$10,000 to be distributed to the officers and men of the
Police Bureau, and has also detailed Mr. Foong Yui-kwun
(豐裕坤), Chief of the Police Administration of the
Ministry of Interior, to come to Shanghai to convey
personally the appreciation of the Government.
    It is reported that General Tsai Ching-chun,
Commissioner of the local Police Bureau, has decided to
distribute only half of the sum, when received, to the
officers and men as reward, and to purchase Liberty Bonds
with the other half.    He held that the police officers were
doing nothing more than their duty in maintaining peace and
assisting in defending the territory.

Lih Pao
（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER 14 SEP. 1937）

S.I.

1937年9月13日。    |    下午译文
                                  * 上海

《时事新报》及其他本地报纸：-

奖励地方警察局官员一万元

    自本地战事爆发以来，上海市政府警察局全体官员，从局长以下，均积极履行职责，既参与前线作战，又维持后方秩序。鉴于此，国民政府下令发放一万元奖金，分发给警察局官兵，并特派内政部警政司司长丰裕坤先生前往上海，亲自传达政府的嘉许之意。
    据悉，当地警察局局长蔡劲军将军决定，收到款项后，仅将一半作为奖金分发给官兵，另一半则用于购买公债。他认为，警察官员在维护和平及协助保卫国土方面，所做的不过是其分内之事。

立报
（印章：副警务总监 1937年9月14日）

S.I.
